params.blsG1: BN254 G1 public key (p2p/engine identity), affine coordinates.
params.blsG2: BN254 G2 public key, affine coordinates [x.c0, x.c1, y.c0, y.c1] —                the order `CommonwarePublicKeys::from_string_coordinates` consumes.

admin().notice: Bootstrap/emergency authority: wires the registry and arbiter, and can drive         the registry's owner surface directly if the mirror ever needs manual repair         (the registry's `owner` is immutable, so there is no ownership handoff to         fall back to).

arbiter().notice: The slashing arbiter allowed to call `eject`. One-shot.

commitNext().notice: Apply the oldest announced registry change once eligible. Permissionless         passthrough of `commitNextChange`; cleans the sidecar up when the committed         change was a deregistration.

eject(address).notice: Immediate forced removal of a proven-misbehaving operator — arbiter-only.         Clears any queued change first (targeted cancel), then force-deregisters,         with no time gate between them. Idempotent for already-removed operators so         a slash transaction can never fail on the ejection leg.

getOperatorSet().notice: The full operator set with p2p sidecar and live registry weights — the one         read the off-chain bootstrap needs. Operators queued behind a notice window         report weight 0 until their registration commits.

join(uint256,uint256,uint256,address,uin.notice: Join the Schnorr signer set. Caller must be a registered Commitments operator         whose address IS the Ethereum address of the submitted Schnorr key (the same         identity invariant the off-chain node asserts at startup), with quantized         stake >= 1. Uses the immediate path when the registry has no notice window,         the announce queue otherwise (commit via `commitNext` once eligible).

leave().notice: Voluntary exit from the signer set. Respects the notice window when one is         configured (capital exit is separate: `requestUnbond` on the manager).

operatorRegistry().notice: The Commitments operator registry that is the stake source of truth.

quantizedStake(address).notice: Quantized live Commitments stake for `operator` (the weight `syncWeight`         would mirror).

setArbiter(address).notice: Wire the slashing arbiter allowed to `eject`. One-shot.

setRegistry(address).notice: Point the adapter at the registry it owns. One-shot: the registry is         constructed with this adapter as its immutable owner, so the deploy order is         adapter -> registry(owner = adapter) -> `setRegistry`.

syncWeight(address).notice: Permissionless crank reconciling one operator's registry weight with its         live Commitments stake. Deregisters operators that stopped being         Commitments-registered or whose quantized stake hit zero.

updateNodeInfo(uint256[2],uint256[4],str.notice: Refresh the published p2p sidecar (socket move, key rotation happens via         leave + rejoin since the Schnorr key is the identity).

weightScale().notice: Divisor quantizing raw Commitments stake units into registry `uint96` weight.
